review_scope: Favorites import, CLI/MCP dispatch, source requests, queue deduplication, nightly scheduling and worker restart. Engineering review with targeted security regressions; no formal repository-wide scan.
verified_checks: Owner binding survives completed scans and restart
Concurrent PostgreSQL submissions create one job
Manual and favorite URLs share exact note-ID deduplication
Nightly sync does not revive expired failures
Queued tokens refresh while running/completed jobs are preserved
MCP child receives explicit text and video profiles
Real nightly service completed without adding duplicate jobs
Login and worker share a browser-profile lock
MCP profile propagation and scheduler exit codes covered by regression tests
limits: Platform login can expire and require owner QR verification
All favorites use requested cooking collection; automatic topic routing is not implemented
Timer requires powered-on networked host; missed run is caught up after boot
